# TensorFlow Playground

> An interactive neural network visualization tool that makes deep learning concepts accessible through hands-on experimentation and real-time network training.

TensorFlow Playground is an educational web application that allows users to visualize and interact with neural networks in real-time. Built with TensorFlow.js and inspired by similar visualization tools, it serves as an essential resource for students and practitioners learning deep learning fundamentals.

## Key Topics

- Neural Networks
- Deep Learning
- TensorFlow
- Interactive Visualization
- Educational Tool
- Neural Network Training
- Activation Functions
- Backpropagation
- Machine Learning
- Web-based Demo
- Open Source
- convnet.js
- Real-time Learning
- Network Architecture

## Interactive Playground

- [A Neural Network Playground](https://playground.tensorflow.org): Interactive TensorFlow neural network visualization tool for deep learning education where users can build, train, and visualize neural networks in real-time
